skills.name: Regained Memory
skills.description: You recover your true power by recovering your lost memory.

skills.name: Three Snails
skills.description:
[Master Level : 3]
Hurls snail shells to attack monsters from long distance.

skills.name: Recovery
skills.description:
[Master Level: 3]
Allows you to steadily recover HP for 30 sec. 
Cooldown: 2 min

skills.name: Agile Body
skills.description:
[Master Level : 3]
Explosive speed for an instant. 
Takes about 1 min. until the next call.

skills.name: Legendary Spirit
skills.description:
[Master Level: 1]
With the aid of a legendary spirit, you can now use scrolls on items that you can't equip.

skills.name: Combat Step
skills.description:
Tap any direction key twice to dash. 
If you use the Jump key or this skill while in mid-air, you will jump once more in the direction headed. Also permanently increases your Speed and Max Movement Speed.
[Command: Right, Right or press Jump]
Right-click to lock Direction Key Tapping command.

skills.name: Return to Rien
skills.description: Return to Rien, the small island covered in ice and snow.

skills.name: Smash Swing
skills.description:
Calls upon Aran's muscle memory to swing the polearm 3 times in a row, hard. You can move while hitting, and momentarily stop falling by using it while jumping.
[Command: Tap the Attack Key multiple times]

skills.name: Smash Swing
skills.description:
Calls upon Aran's muscle memory to swing the polearm 3 times in a row, hard. You can move while hitting, and momentarily stop falling by using it while jumping.
[Command: Tap the Attack Key multiple times]

skills.name: Agile Polearms
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Ol' Reliable
skills.description: Increases DEF, ATT, and Critical Rate by working on the foundations of a warrior.

skills.name: Smash Swing
skills.description:
Calls upon Aran's muscle memory to swing the polearm 3 times in a row, hard. You can move while hitting, and momentarily stop falling by using it while jumping.
[Command: Tap the Attack Key multiple times]

skills.name: Final Charge
skills.description:
Charges forward, quickly knocking back enemies in your path. Can be resisted by some enemies.
After learning Beyond Blade Mastery II, can be used during Beyond Blade with a cooldown.
[Command: Down, Right/Down, Left + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Final Toss
skills.description:
Lifts multiple enemies in front of you into the air. Can be resisted by some enemies.
Can be used consecutively a maximum of 2 times on ground.
[Command: Up + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Polearm Mastery
skills.description: Increases Polearm Mastery, Attack Speed, and Final Damage.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Final Attack
skills.description: Chance to deliver an additional hit after a direct attack skill. Must have a polearm equipped.

skills.name: Combo Ability
skills.description:
Unlocks the true power of combos.
Combos automatically increase over time or when landing direct skill attacks.
Your Attack Power and Speed increase each time your Combo Count stacks. Permanently increases Critical Rate and Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Beyond Blade
skills.description: Summon all of Aran's power to move like the divine Black Tortoise and sweep enemies away with Maha.

skills.name: Drain
skills.description:
Absorbs some of the damage you dealt to the enemies as HP.
Permanently increases your Max HP.
Can be toggled On/Off

skills.name: Snow Charge
skills.description:
Permanently increases damage and infuses your polearm with the powers of the ice spirit for a short time.
Can be toggled On/Off

skills.name: Advanced Combo Ability
skills.description:
Unleash even more powerful combat abilities by becoming a true master of combos. Combo Ability will always apply its maximum effect.
Permanently increases Attack Power, Status Resistance, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Adrenaline Rush
skills.description:
Harness the experience of countless battlefields to push your battle prowess to the pinnacle of mortal ability.
The deadly chill of Aran's polearm materializes as Iceflow.
Unaffected by Buff Duration increases.

skills.name: Might
skills.description: Increases Attack Power, Defense, Critical Rate, and Boss Damage, and allows you to knock enemies back with a small amount of damage.

skills.name: Beyond Blade Mastery I
skills.description:
Aran's connection with Maha grows stronger, recalling more of the Polearm Warrior's legendary strength. The fortitude of the Black Tortoise unites with the grace of the Vermilion Bird to enhance Beyond Blade.
While using this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back.

skills.name: High Defense
skills.description: Masters new defensive techniques to decrease damage taken and increase max HP, DEF, and Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Maha Blessing
skills.description: Calls on the power of Maha, the spirit of the polearm, to increase all party members' Attack Power and Magic ATT.

skills.name: Judgment Draw
skills.description:
Slams your polearm into the ground with great force, launching nearby enemies into the air. Can be resisted by some enemies.
[Command: Up, Right/Up, Left + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Adrenaline Rush Activate
skills.description:
Activates Adrenaline Rush if you use the skill while Adrenaline Rush is available. Once Adrenaline Rush ends, your combos reset to 0.
Shares skill level with Adrenaline Rush.
After acquiring Adrenaline Overload, you can activate Adrenal Awakening by using the skill again when Adrenal Awakening is available.
Use the skill while pressing the Down Arrow key to immediately activate Adrenal Awakening when it is available. With Action Customization enabled, you can immediately activate Adrenal Awakening without the arrow keys.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization On/Off.

skills.name: Beyond Blade
skills.description:
Aran's connection with Maha grows stronger, recalling more of the Polearm Warrior's legendary strength. The fortitude of the Black Tortoise unites with the grace of the Vermilion Bird to enhance Beyond Blade.
While using this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back.

skills.name: Beyond Blade

skills.name: Permafrost
skills.description:
Summon the bitter cold within Maha as a polearm that freezes the very air around it for a set duration. Permafrost's duration does not increase with the summon duration increase. Unaffected by attack reflection.
[Command: Down + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: High Mastery
skills.description: Maxes out Polearm Mastery while increasing Attack Power, Critical Damage, and Final Damage.

skills.name: Beyond Blade Mastery II
skills.description:
Aran's connection with Maha grows even stronger, recalling more of the Polearm Warrior's legendary strength. The Black Tortoise and Vermilion Bird are joined by the overwhelming might of the Azure Dragon to further enhance Beyond Blade.
While using this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back.

skills.name: Adrenaline Overload
skills.description:
Harmonize the full power of Maha and your combos with the remembered thrill of a thousand battlefields, surpassing Adrenaline Rush.
Activates Adrenal Awakening, allowing you to unleash Maha's full might by landing a certain number of attacks while Adrenaline Rush is active.
Adrenal Awakening enables Hyper Finisher Skills and allows you to deal additional damage to enemies by channeling Maha's power into a Golden Burst.
Adrenal Awakening does not affect the duration of Adrenaline Rush.
Unaffected by Buff Duration increases.

skills.name: Sudden Strike
skills.description: Revisit the fundamentals of your technique with the benefit of your hard-earned experience.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack
skills.description: Permanently increases Attack Power. Greatly increases the damage and activation rate of your Final Attacks.

skills.name: Cleaving Attack
skills.description: Increases Damage and Ignore Defense due to Aran's diligent training.

skills.name: Permafrost - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Permafrost.

skills.name: Permafrost - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Permafrost.

skills.name: Permafrost - Persist
skills.description: Increases the duration of Permafrost.

skills.name: Finisher - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Finisher and Hyper Finisher skills.

skills.name: Finisher - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases amount of enemy DEF that Finisher and Hyper Finisher skills ignore.

skills.name: Surging Adrenaline
skills.description: Increases the duration of Adrenaline Rush.

skills.name: Beyond-er Blade
skills.description: Increases the damage of Beyond Blade and Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger.

skills.name: Beyond Blade Barrage
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Beyond Blade and Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger.

skills.name: Piercing Beyond Blade
skills.description: Increases the amount of enemy DEF that Beyond Blade and Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger ignore.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Glacial Prison
skills.description:
Loose the glacial winds imprisoned within your polearm to cut off your enemy's retreat. Affected enemies cannot be stunned again by Glacial Prison or other skills for 90 seconds.
[Command: Up, Down + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.description:
Muster the polearm's power for a powerful blow.
You will become invincible and can change the attack direction while holding the skill key down.
Can only be used once after activating Adrenaline Rush or Adrenal Awakening.
[Command: Down, Right, Down/Down, Left, Down + Attack
Key (held down)]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Heroic Memories
skills.description: Recalls the oath of the Maple Heroes to increase damage.

skills.name: Hyper Finisher - Last Stand
skills.description:
Harness the unbreakable will of a hero to unleash a slash enhanced with Maha's power.
Can only be used once while Adrenal Awakening is active.

skills.name: Hyper Finisher - Last Stand
skills.description: Draws out Aran's maximum strength to sweep away the enemies with Maha. Will not be pushed back by any enemy attack when using Beyond Blade.

skills.name: Hyper Finisher - Last Stand
skills.description: Draws out Aran's maximum strength to sweep away the enemies with Maha. Will not be pushed back by any enemy attack when using Beyond Blade.

skills.name: Maha's Blessing
skills.description: Channel the power of Maha, Spirit of Polearm, as a powerful protective barrier to negate an enemy's attack.

skills.name: Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger
skills.description:
The full strength of Aran's connection with Maha returns, restoring the legendary power of the Polearm Warrior. Aran's techniques harness the full might of the Black Tortoise, Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, along with the majestic White Tiger, completing Beyond Blade.
Beyond Blade can be used again after Beyond Blade's 3rd hit. While using this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back.

skills.name: Maha's Carnage
skills.description:
Swings Maha around in a circle, leaving a trail of destruction in his wake.
While using this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back. Unaffected by Attack Ignore and Attack Reflection.
[Command: Down, Down + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Blizzard Tempest
skills.description:
Create a powerful blizzard that calls down the Dire Wolf's Curse upon enemies.
Hitting enemies afflicted by the Dire Wolf's Curse with direct skill attacks increases the curse's power, creating an ice shard that deals additional damage.
The Dire Wolf's Curse applies to the enemy with the highest max HP first, and ice shards ignore attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle the ice shard effect ON/OFF

skills.name: Blizzard Tempest
skills.description: Cast the Dire Wolf's Curse on nearby enemies.

skills.name: Finisher - Adrenaline Surge
skills.description:
Unlocks the power of pure adrenaline.
Increases the duration of Adrenal Awakening permanently, and using the skill while Adrenaline Rush or Adrenal Awakening are active releases an explosive blizzard that attacks enemies.
Can only be used once while Adrenaline Rush or Adrenal Awakening are active. Not affected by attack reflection.
[Command: Up, Up + Attack Key]
Right-click to lock command

skills.name: Hyper Finisher - Adrenaline Surge
